rejected.reason: claim text changes only through proposed_statement_changes

reasons: The scalar critical index must be translated back to the two-budget scale when finite.
The radial critical-budget report requires a declared nonzero direction in the budget rectangle.
The radial path used by the critical-budget construction must be declared.
The infimum alone does not distinguish failure at entry from failure immediately after entry.
The requested breakdown summary needs the first conclusion-failure index.
The radial report requires a model-feasibility entry index.
The radial report requires a positive-denominator target-entry index distinct from model entry.
A separate failure set prevents pre-target emptiness from being counted as robustness or breakdown.
The construction must distinguish model feasibility from existence of the survivor-complier target.
The construction separately records the first radial point at which the observed model is feasible.
The construction correction introduces new declared outputs and inputs, so the complete definition metadata must be replaced atomically with the formula proposal.

correct: The existing construction defines the robust set but omits the requested pathwise feasibility, target-entry, and conclusion-failure diagnostics. The corrected construction preserves the robust set and adds three radial sets, extended-real infima, an attainment bit, and a critical budget pair without evaluating L outside its domain.

comparator-promise-table-replace: The zero-budget algorithm and lifting are prior accepted-bank contributions, not new positive-budget contributions. The comparator table now records boundary recovery and limits the present extension to the disjunctive joint-violation regime.
The narrowed claim introduces radial symbols and requires synchronized free-symbol metadata and result notes.

narrow: The current statement equates the locus L=t with the conclusion boundary. Equality plateaus can lie in the relative interior of the robust region, so the true boundary label requires a two-sided closure test within the target-nonempty domain. The corrected statement also connects the mandated radial critical-budget report.

narrow: The current wording assigns endpoint formulas on every nonempty chart stratum even though def:endpoints leaves both endpoints undefined when all compatible laws have H=0. The corrected claim partitions every stratum into three exhaustive labels and supplies formulas only on target-nonempty strata.

verdict.note: Accepted radial diagnostics, symbols, target-nonempty chart restriction, and scoped accepted-bank metadata after independent adjudication. Rejected prop:breakdown-frontier because closure-meets-both-sides is not pointwise boundary membership and exact rational root isolation also needs rational t. Explicitly accepted the unlanded projection statement variant because it lacked the accepted-bank comparison.
